ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed towards low-intensity (black) pixels; white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.05, with high-intensity pixels localized strictly to scarring and parasitic clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity field across both lobes; small high-intensity contiguous blobs (barnacles) localized at lateral tips; sparse linear and circular high-contrast pixel clusters distributed medially.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree convergence; deep pixel penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; approximately 9-11 distinct peaks per lobe lobe isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward convexity (dorsal-directed curve) ending in sharp, acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel aggregates (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary clusters visible on the lower-left fluke margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent high-contrast linear marks; includes a large intersecting 'X' pattern on the mid-right lobe and several thin horizontal/diagonal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the right lobe; two distinct high-contrast circular scars on the left lobe medially.
other_distinctive_markers: One singular, perfectly circular white 'O' shaped scar located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
